description: This file contains a reporting script for the 'Item Prices' report within the ERPNext system. It fetches and formats various item details, including prices, purchase rates, BOM rates, and valuation rates, to generate a structured report for stock items.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main entry point for executing the item prices report. It prepares columns, fetches item details, prices, purchase rates, BOM rates, and valuation rates, then constructs and returns report data.

methods.name: get_columns(filters)
methods.description: Returns the report's column headers based on filters.

methods.name: get_item_details(conditions)
methods.description: Retrieves details of items from the database based on specified conditions.

methods.name: get_price_list()
methods.description: Fetches selling and buying price lists for each item, formatting the prices with currency and list name.

methods.name: get_last_purchase_rate()
methods.description: Gathers the latest purchase rate for each item from purchase orders, receipts, and invoices.

methods.name: get_item_bom_rate()
methods.description: Calculates the BOM rate for active, default BOMs for each item.

methods.name: get_valuation_rate()
methods.description: Calculates the average valuation rate for each item across warehouses.

methods.name: get_condition(filters)
methods.description: Builds SQL condition clauses based on filter options to filter items.
